citations.assessment: The unit explicitly names Rabbi Acha and Rabbi Tachlifa, his father-in-law, in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachman’s name. Their proof text concerns recitation upon going to bed. Heilprin’s title Rav is retained.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
